correctness.rationale: Two independent precise BFS geodesic counters and brute-force all 2^21 labeled seven-vertex graphs yield M(7)=49 and full permutation-orbit equality classification; a separate Graph Atlas NetworkX check matches. Exhausting all 1044 known unlabeled seven-vertex graphs and all 128 eighth-vertex neighbourhoods covers every eight-vertex isomorphism class. Exact counting of all 133632 extensions yields M(8)=74, and every maximizing extension belongs to one of the two explicit full permutation orbits; explicit arithmetic matches. The premise of completeness of the published Graph Atlas is disclosed; no claim of an infinite proof or orders n>=9.
